_metadata.description: Synthetic evaluation dataset for AICTE OneView overlap/duplicate detection engine.
_metadata.notice: These are SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION EXAMPLES created for evaluation purposes only. They are NOT official AICTE complaint records and do not represent real cases or real individuals.

label_schema.duplicate: Complaints that describe the same incident and should be merged
label_schema.related_independent: Complaints that share context (institution/category) but describe distinct incidents
label_schema.unrelated: Complaints that are clearly about different subjects or institutions

_metadata.label_note: Labels are kept separate from input features. Do not use labels as prediction features.
